schema.statisticBasis: elapsedMs from original-precision raw JSON; select exact window then median/MAD/min/max; never pool sides/runtimes
schema.display: all millisecond cells rounded to six decimals; no per-unit arithmetic; raw reports retain original precision
schema.raw_ms: selected elapsedMs in original raw occurrence order, pipe-separated; selected_count must match
schema.first_last: first and last observed records, including excluded first/early phases; no scalar/context/register/owner copies
schema.workObjects: sparse top-level numeric observation fields; expected-prefixed fields remain explicitly expected, not hidden physical instrumentation
schema.denominator_work: work/units from deduplicated checked fixture definition, not a measured physical-access total
schema.floorFlag: chrome_median_below_1ms is descriptive; no ns/unit or precise tiny-packet ratio claim

ceilings: Single-host descriptive medians and MAD are not confidence intervals.
Candidate-only definitions include an inherited IA32e anchor; newly admitted behavior has no executable predecessor speedup denominator.
Factory creation includes fixture construction. Cache gauges are final resident values, never sums over resumed calls.
Expected semantic table bytes and native boundary references are not whole-engine physical-read instrumentation.
Historical baseline/current identify each separate counterfactual; never multiply their ratios into an end-to-end speedup.
The bounded linear diagnostic-clear probe was not retained; the final source and Core were restored exactly.
